list.name: Changes
list.comment:
feat(auth): update baseURL and trusted origins for enhanced flexibility and local development support
- Refactored `baseURL` to support multiple hosts with protocol and fallback configurations. - Updated `trustedOrigins` to include localhost and wildcard subdomains for local testing.

Basic dashboard up

feat(dashboard): integrate dynamic tenant-specific data and discovery directory
- Replaced static dashboard logic with tenant-specific membership, attendance, and metric data fetched from the backend. - Added secure server-to-server call utilities using Bearer tokens. - Introduced `DiscoverGymsPage` for exploring partner gyms with search and filter functionality. - Removed deprecated ESLint configuration.

feat(dashboard): import `headers` from Next.js for future enhancements
- Added `headers` import to `page.tsx` for improved request handling flexibility. - Updated project workspace configurations for IDE enhancements and indexing.

feat(discover): implement dynamic gym discovery with backend integration
- Replaced mock data with dynamic tenant fetching using `react-query`. - Integrated secure API calls leveraging user session tokens. - Introduced membership linking and portal redirection logic. - Enhanced UI/UX with loading/error states and deferred search input handling. - Updated dependencies: added `sonner` for toasts and `next-themes` for theming.

feat(discover): modularize client and server logic for gym discovery
- Extracted client-side gym discovery logic to `DiscoverGymsClient`. - Improved server-side session validation and token forwarding. - Removed deprecated logic and simplified `DiscoverGymsPage` structure. - Updated `Header` and `Sidebar` for UI consistency. - Removed unused sidebar item `Favorites`.

feat(platform): restructure app architecture and enhance modularity
- Moved core components and pages under the `platform` directory for improved separation of concerns. - Introduced centralized authentication and API utilities with `betterAuth` and `striveClientFetch`. - Added tenant onboarding flows with `ProvisionTenantPage` and `ProvisionTenantClient`. - Enhanced theming and UI consistency using shared Tailwind configurations. - Refactored database schema for stricter type safety and snake_case conventions.

feat(tenants): implement dynamic multi-tenant layouts and admin console
- Added a new tenant-specific `layout.tsx` to support dynamic theming and UI rendering. - Introduced admin console with secure server-to-server calls for membership, invoices, and attendance data. - Enhanced proxy logic for subdomain resolution and tenant ID injection. - Added utilities like `useIsMobile` for responsive design and `striveClientFetch` for multi-tenant API requests.

feat(member): implement dynamic member dashboard, sidebar, and activity tracking
- Added a tenant-specific member dashboard with server-to-server metrics integration and mock fallback data. - Introduced an activity tracking feature with extensible filters and detailed workout tracking. - Implemented a responsive sidebar for navigation with logout functionality and badge support. - Enhanced UI/UX with interactive charts, gamification elements, and progress visualization.

feat(ui): refactor components for consistent theming and improve accessibility
- Standardized colors and styles across components for better theme consistency. - Updated `LoginPage`, `DiscoverClient`, and `TenantMemberSidebar` with accessible text and color contrast. - Refactored UI elements (e.g., buttons, badges, headers) to use scalable, reusable classes. - Enhanced layout alignment and spacing for smoother responsive design.

feat(auth): refactor login page with interactive forms and improved error handling
- Migrated to client-side rendering with React state for better interactivity. - Implemented dynamic form validation and error messages for login and Google sign-in. - Redesigned UI for enhanced branding and responsive usability. - Configured experimental Next.js features for local dev origins.

feat(ui): add customizable `Select` component with enhanced accessibility and theming
- Implemented a reusable and modular `Select` component leveraging `@base-ui/react/select`. - Added support for customization of triggers, labels, groups, items, and separators. - Enhanced keyboard navigation and screen reader support for improved accessibility. - Integrated consistent theming with utility classes and dark mode support.

feat(dashboard): refactor tenant URL generation logic for improved readability and flexibility
- Replaced hardcoded URLs with a dynamic `NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL` environment variable. - Updated URL construction for admin console links to use `URL` object.

feat(dashboard): add subdomain extraction logic for tenant identification
- Implemented fallback logic to extract active subdomain from `window.location.hostname` for multi-tenant support. - Ensures compatibility with subdomain isolation setups excluding localhost.

feat(tenants): refactor multi-tenant layout and improve routing logic
- Merged `[subdomain]` and generic tenant layouts into a unified structure for better maintainability. - Refactored tenant routing to dynamically generate exploration and login URLs based on environment. - Simplified component structure for sidebar and main content rendering with clear isolation. - Enhanced UI transitions with new animations for smoother rendering.
refactor(tenants): move tenant layout to subdomain-specific folder for better structure

feat(auth): update baseURL and trusted origins for enhanced flexibility and local development support
- Refactored `baseURL` to support multiple hosts with protocol and fallback configurations. - Updated `trustedOrigins` to include localhost and wildcard subdomains for local testing.
